## AI Copilot

Draft-reply / summarize-thread / suggest-next-action over the one-shot LLM surface, grounded ONLY on the caller-supplied thread and KB articles, citations returned as data. NEVER writes a card: accepting a draft is a separate, attributed act — the agent saves it as their own outbound Customer Reply.

### Non-goals

No autonomous sends, no realm search, no memory between calls. Choosing the articles belongs to Suggest KB Articles.
